checks.what: adaptation asymptote has the expected size and sign: 40-45 deg for the 45 deg rotations, 5-12 deg for the 20 deg clamp

differences: The adaptation asymptotes (mean of the last 10 learning trials, baseline corrected, compensation positive) in the preprint of this paper are 42.85, 42.38, 43.12 (Experiments 1-3) and 8.68 (Experiment 5); recomputed here from the hand directions they are 42.43, 41.96, 42.41, 8.30. They sit 0.4 to 0.7 deg lower, so they are not listed as reproduced. Likely causes: the preprint defines the endpoint at 9 cm and the task program logged a 10 cm radius (computing Experiment 1 at 9 cm gives 42.67), and the authors' outlier removal and exact baseline are not specified in enough detail to repeat. Only the participant counts are listed as reproduced.
The checks use the 2021 bioRxiv preprint of the paper (the journal text could not be read), so numbers may differ from the final article.
